A Day on the Farm: 城市孩子第一次参观农场的经历。
Anna lives in the city. This weekend, she visits her uncle's farm with her parents. The farm is big and quiet.
In the morning, Anna feeds the chickens and collects the eggs. The eggs are warm and brown. She also drinks fresh milk from a cow.
Anna loves the farm. At night, she sees many stars in the sky. In the city, she can never see so many stars.
